Predict TALE target boxes

Source: R/target_predictions.R
tales_predict_targets.Rd

Runs a TALE target (EBE) prediction tool over a set of TALE RVD sequences and a set of DNA sequences, and returns the predictions as a tibble.

Usage

tales_predict_targets(x, subj_file, method = c("talvez", "preditale"), ...)

Arguments

x

TALE RVD sequences: a tales object, the path to a fasta file, or a BStringSet. A tales is rendered with tales_rvd_strings, which drops the termini.

subj_file

Path to a fasta file of subject DNA sequence(s).

method

Which backend to use, "talvez" (default) or "preditale".

...

Passed to the chosen backend. See talvez (opt_param, talvez_dir, conda_bin) and preditale (opt_param, predictor_path); both accept output_dir. Note the two take different opt_param defaults, since the options are the tools' own.

Value

A tibble of EBE predictions, with column names homogenised across backends, plus a method column recording which tool produced them.

Details

talvez and preditale are independent programs, but the package already normalises their outputs to a shared set of column names, so they are interchangeable backends of one operation rather than two separate functions. This is that operation; talvez and preditale remain available and documented individually, and are where each tool's own options and citation live.

See also

talvez, preditale

Other target prediction: plot_target_preds(), preditale(), talvez()
